add_expense:
def add_expense (s : State) (amount : Int) (category : String) (note : Option String := none) : Except String (Nat × State) :=
  if amount ≤ 0 then
    .error "amount must be positive"
  else if category = "" then
    .error "category must not be empty"
  else
    .ok (s.expenses.length + 1, { s with expenses := s.expenses ++ [⟨amount, category, note⟩] })
best_name:
def best_name (g : List (String × Int)) : Option String :=
  pick_first (sort_names (names_of (keep_top g (max_cents g))))
budget_of:
def budget_of (s : State) (c : String) : Int :=
  (find_amount s.budgets c).getD 0
budget_set:
def budget_set (bs : List (String × Int)) (c : String) (a : Int) : List (String × Int) :=
  match bs with
  | [] => [(c, a)]
  | (k, v) :: t => if k = c then (k, a) :: t else (k, v) :: budget_set t c a
by_category:
def by_category (s : State) : List (String × Int) :=
  s.expenses.foldl (fun acc e => group_add acc e.category e.cents) []
find_amount:
def find_amount (bs : List (String × Int)) (c : String) : Option Int :=
  match bs with
  | [] => none
  | (k, v) :: t => if k = c then some v else find_amount t c
fold_max_bound:
theorem fold_max_bound (l : List (String × Int)) (acc : Int) (p : String × Int) (h : p ∈ l) :
    p.2 ≤ l.foldl (fun a q => int_max a q.2) acc := by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [List.mem_cons] at h
    rcases h with hp | hp
    · rw [hp]
      have h1 : x.2 ≤ int_max acc x.2 := int_max_right acc x.2
      have h2 : int_max acc x.2 ≤ xs.foldl (fun a q => int_max a q.2) (int_max acc x.2) :=
        fold_max_ge_init xs (int_max acc x.2)
      omega
    · exact ih (int_max acc x.2) hp
fold_max_ge_init:
theorem fold_max_ge_init (l : List (String × Int)) (acc : Int) :
    acc ≤ l.foldl (fun a p => int_max a p.2) acc := by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    have h1 : acc ≤ int_max acc x.2 := int_max_left acc x.2
    have h2 : int_max acc x.2 ≤ xs.foldl (fun a p => int_max a p.2) (int_max acc x.2) :=
      ih (int_max acc x.2)
    omega
group_add:
def group_add (acc : List (String × Int)) (c : String) (a : Int) : List (String × Int) :=
  match acc with
  | [] => [(c, a)]
  | (k, v) :: t => if k = c then (k, v + a) :: t else (k, v) :: group_add t c a
insert_name:
def insert_name (x : String) (l : List String) : List String :=
  match l with
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: t => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: t else y :: insert_name x t
int_max: def int_max (a b : Int) : Int := if a < b then b else a
int_max_left:
theorem int_max_left (a b : Int) : a ≤ int_max a b := by
  by_cases h : a < b <;> simp [int_max, h] <;> omega
int_max_right:
theorem int_max_right (a b : Int) : b ≤ int_max a b := by
  by_cases h : a < b <;> simp [int_max, h] <;> omega
keep_top:
def keep_top (l : List (String × Int)) (m : Int) : List (String × Int) :=
  match l with
  | [] => []
  | p :: t => if p.2 = m then p :: keep_top t m else keep_top t m
keep_top_mem:
theorem keep_top_mem (l : List (String × Int)) (m : Int) (p : String × Int)
    (h : p ∈ keep_top l m) : p ∈ l ∧ p.2 = m := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [keep_top] at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hx : x.2 = m
    · have h' : p ∈ x :: keep_top xs m := by simpa [keep_top, hx] using h
      rw [List.mem_cons] at h'
      rcases h' with hpx | hpt
      · rw [hpx]
        exact ⟨List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), hx⟩
      · obtain ⟨hmem, hm⟩ := ih hpt
        exact ⟨List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hmem), hm⟩
    · have h' : p ∈ keep_top xs m := by simpa [keep_top, hx] using h
      obtain ⟨hmem, hm⟩ := ih h'
      exact ⟨List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hmem), hm⟩
max_cents:
def max_cents (l : List (String × Int)) : Int :=
  l.foldl (fun acc p => int_max acc p.2) 0
max_cents_bound:
theorem max_cents_bound (l : List (String × Int)) (p : String × Int) (h : p ∈ l) :
    p.2 ≤ max_cents l := by
  unfold max_cents
  exact fold_max_bound l 0 p h
mem_insert_name_of:
theorem mem_insert_name_of (x : String) (l : List String) (c : String)
    (h : c ∈ insert_name x l) : c = x ∨ c ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    simp [insert_name] at h
    exact Or.inl h
  | cons y t ih =>
    by_cases hy : x ≤ y
    · have h' : c ∈ x :: y :: t := by simpa [insert_name, hy] using h
      rw [List.mem_cons] at h'
      rcases h' with hcx | hrest
      · exact Or.inl hcx
      · exact Or.inr hrest
    · have h' : c ∈ y :: insert_name x t := by simpa [insert_name, hy] using h
      rw [List.mem_cons] at h'
      rcases h' with hcy | hrest
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl hcy))
      · rcases ih hrest with hcx | hct
        · exact Or.inl hcx
        · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hct))
mem_sort_names_of:
theorem mem_sort_names_of (l : List String) (c : String) (h : c ∈ sort_names l) : c ∈ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [sort_names] at h
  | cons x t ih =>
    have h' : c ∈ insert_name x (sort_names t) := by simpa [sort_names] using h
    rcases mem_insert_name_of x (sort_names t) c h' with hcx | hct
    · rw [hcx]
      exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr (ih hct))
names_of:
def names_of (l : List (String × Int)) : List String :=
  match l with
  | [] => []
  | p :: t => p.1 :: names_of t
names_of_mem:
theorem names_of_mem (l : List (String × Int)) (c : String) (h : c ∈ names_of l) :
    ∃ p, p ∈ l ∧ p.1 = c := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [names_of] at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h' : c ∈ x.1 :: names_of xs := by simpa [names_of] using h
    rw [List.mem_cons] at h'
    rcases h' with hc | hc
    · exact ⟨x, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl), hc.symm⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, hmem, hpc⟩ := ih hc
      exact ⟨p, List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hmem), hpc⟩
over_budget:
def over_budget (s : State) : List String :=
  ((s.budgets.filter (fun p => decide (budget_of s p.1 < spent_in s p.1))).map (fun p => p.1)).mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))
pick_first:
def pick_first (l : List String) : Option String :=
  match l with
  | [] => none
  | c :: _ => some c
pick_first_mem:
theorem pick_first_mem (l : List String) (c : String) (h : pick_first l = some c) :
    c ∈ l := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp [pick_first] at h
  | cons x xs =>
    have hx : x = c := by simpa [pick_first] using h
    rw [← hx]
    exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
set_budget:
def set_budget (s : State) (category : String) (amount : Int) : Except String (Int × State) :=
  if amount < 0 then
    .error "budget must not be negative"
  else
    .ok (amount, { s with budgets := budget_set s.budgets category amount })
sort_names:
def sort_names (l : List String) : List String :=
  match l with
  | [] => []
  | x :: t => insert_name x (sort_names t)
spent_in:
def spent_in (s : State) (c : String) : Int :=
  (find_amount (by_category s) c).getD 0
top_category:
def top_category (s : State) : Option String :=
  best_name (by_category s)
